_comment: Golden wire shape for the NEW scope-wide aggregate CSAT analytics read endpoint (GET /api/v1/analytics/csat — the aggregate-across-queues option chosen by the product owner 2026-07-13, resolving ADR-0020's open KPI-card question). The envelope carries the tenant/scope rollup; each queues[] row reuses the existing per-queue projection src/Verbara.Platform.Api/Dtos/CsatResponseDto.cs VERBATIM (queueName, channel, totalResponses, averageRating, rangeStart, rangeEnd). `channel` echoes the requested filter and is `all` when unfiltered. Every child change's delta spec must cite these field names VERBATIM (verbatim-fixture-citation rule, /xr:propagate).
